props.doc: Threat intelligence providers. All read-only except contributing an observation back to MISP, which is how a SOC stops only consuming intelligence.
props.name: intel_connectors

props.code:
def param(kind, **extra):
    """One input property, in JSON Schema terms."""
    spec = {"type": kind} if kind not in ("ipv4", "hostname") else {"type": "string"}
    spec.update(extra)
    return spec


def cmd(key, name, method, url, inputs, outputs, extract=None, risk="low",
        effect="read", doc="", techniques=None, undo=None, timeout_ms=30000,
        required=None, category="integration", body=None, success=None):
    """
    One command definition.

    Structured JSON in, structured JSON out. The output_schema is what the
    playbook validator type-checks the next step against, so a command whose
    schema lies fails at publish rather than at 03:00.
    """
    definition = {
        "key": key,
        "name": name,
        "category": category,
        "kind": "http",
        "input_schema": {
            "type": "object",
            "required": list(inputs.keys()) if required is None else required,
            "properties": inputs,
            "additionalProperties": False,
        },
        "output_schema": {"type": "object", "properties": outputs},
        "implementation": {
            "method": method,
            "url": url,
            "extract": extract or {},
            "success_codes": success or [200, 201, 202, 204],
        },
        "required_permissions": ["commands.execute"],
        "required_capabilities": ["net"],
        "timeout_ms": timeout_ms,
        "risk_level": risk,
        "effect": effect,
        "trust_level": "trusted",
        "technique_ids": techniques or [],
        "doc": doc,
    }
    if body is not None:
        definition["implementation"]["body"] = body
    if effect == "mutating":
        # A mutating command with no dry-run example would make dry run a lie,
        # and the registry validator refuses it.
        definition["dry_run_example"] = {"dry_run": True, "would_call": key}
    if undo:
        # Named, not inferred. The platform never invents a rollback.
        definition["undo_command"] = undo
    if risk == "high":
        definition["required_permissions"] = ["commands.execute", _permission_for(key)]
    return definition


def _permission_for(key):
    """High-risk commands need the response permission that matches them."""
    action = key.split(".", 1)[1]
    if "isolate" in action or "contain" in action or "quarantine_host" in action:
        return "response.isolate"
    if "block" in action:
        return "response.block"
    if "disable" in action or "suspend" in action:
        return "response.disable_account"
    if "revoke" in action or "signout" in action:
        return "response.revoke_sessions"
    if "delete" in action or "purge" in action or "remove_mail" in action:
        return "response.delete_mail"
    if "firewall" in action or "policy" in action:
        return "response.firewall"
    return "response.isolate"


def field(name, label, kind="text", required=True, default=None,
          options=None, help="", placeholder=""):
    # One thing an operator must be told before this tool can be reached.
    return {
        "name": name, "label": label, "kind": kind, "required": required,
        "default": default, "options": options or [], "help": help,
        "placeholder": placeholder,
    }


def connector(cid, name, vendor, category, auth, base_url, allowlist, commands,
              min_permissions=None, rate_limit=None, health=None,
              version="1.0.0", setup=None, derive=None, ingest=None,
              hunt=None):
    # A connector manifest. Installing one publishes its commands; no engine
    # change.
    #
    # setup is what THIS vendor needs before it can be reached, and no two
    # agree: CrowdStrike wants a cloud region, Sentinel a tenant and a
    # workspace, Splunk a host and a port. Asking every connector for a
    # client id and a secret asked the two questions they happen to share
    # and none of the ones that make a connection work.
    fields = list(setup or [])

    # Which setting the commands of this connector actually read. Most say
    # base_url; a few front a protocol that is not HTTP and say gateway_url
    # instead, and asking those for a base_url nothing reads is how a form
    # grows a field that does nothing.
    setting = "base_url"
    if "{{" in base_url:
        inner = base_url.split("{{", 1)[1].split("}}", 1)[0].strip()
        setting = inner.rsplit(".", 1)[-1] if inner else "base_url"

    if not any(f["name"] == setting for f in fields):
        # Every connector can at least be pointed elsewhere: a regional
        # cloud, a tenant-specific host, an on-premise appliance.
        # A connector whose base_url is itself a template has no host until
        # someone supplies one, so there is nothing to prefill and the field
        # is the only way the connection can exist at all.
        templated = "{{" in base_url
        fields.insert(0, field(
            setting, "API base URL", kind="url",
            default=None if templated else base_url,
            help="Change for a regional cloud or an on-premise appliance."
                 if not templated else "The hostname this tenant answers on."))

    return {
        "setup": fields,
        # Settings a vendor addresses by a composite of the ones a person
        # can actually be asked for. Nobody knows their workspace ARM id;
        # everybody knows their subscription, resource group and workspace
        # name, and the id is those three in a fixed shape.
        "derive": derive or {},
        # How this product is polled for alerts: which command lists them,
        # which turns ids into objects, and where the timestamp lives that
        # the watermark advances to. A connector without it can still
        # receive a webhook; it just cannot be asked.
        "ingest": ingest or {},
        # Which command runs an arbitrary hunt query, what the query
        # parameter is called, and what language an engineer is writing.
        # A tool without this cannot be hunted in - which is most of them,
        # because a firewall is not a place you go looking.
        "hunt": hunt or {},
        "id": cid, "name": name, "vendor": vendor, "category": category,
        "version": version, "auth": auth, "base_url": base_url,
        "egress_allowlist": allowlist,
        "min_vendor_permissions": min_permissions or [],
        "rate_limit": rate_limit or {},
        "health_check": health or {},
        "commands": commands,
        "publisher": "master-soar",
        "signature": "",
    }


verdict_out = {"malicious": {"type": "integer"}, "suspicious": {"type": "integer"},
               "harmless": {"type": "integer"}, "reputation": {"type": "integer"}}

virustotal = connector(
    "virustotal.v3", "VirusTotal", "Google", "threat_intel",
    {"kind": "api_key", "roles": ["api_key"], "header": "x-apikey"},
    "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3",
    ["www.virustotal.com"],
    min_permissions=["read"], rate_limit={"per_minute": 4},
    health={"path": "/users/current"},
    commands=[
        cmd("virustotal.ip_report", "VirusTotal: IP Report", "GET",
            "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/{{ inputs.ip | urlencode }}",
            {"ip": param("string")}, verdict_out,
            {"malicious": "$.data.attributes.last_analysis_stats.malicious",
             "suspicious": "$.data.attributes.last_analysis_stats.suspicious",
             "harmless": "$.data.attributes.last_analysis_stats.harmless",
             "reputation": "$.data.attributes.reputation"}),

        cmd("virustotal.domain_report", "VirusTotal: Domain Report", "GET",
            "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/{{ inputs.domain | urlencode }}",
            {"domain": param("string")}, verdict_out,
            {"malicious": "$.data.attributes.last_analysis_stats.malicious",
             "reputation": "$.data.attributes.reputation"}),

        cmd("virustotal.file_report", "VirusTotal: File Report", "GET",
            "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/files/{{ inputs.hash | urlencode }}",
            {"hash": param("string")},
            dict(verdict_out, name={"type": "string"},
                 first_seen={"type": "string"}),
            {"malicious": "$.data.attributes.last_analysis_stats.malicious",
             "name": "$.data.attributes.meaningful_name",
             "first_seen": "$.data.attributes.first_submission_date"}),

        cmd("virustotal.url_report", "VirusTotal: URL Report", "GET",
            "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/urls/{{ inputs.url_id | urlencode }}",
            {"url_id": param("string")}, verdict_out,
            {"malicious": "$.data.attributes.last_analysis_stats.malicious"}),
    ],
)

abuseipdb = connector(
    "abuseipdb.v2", "AbuseIPDB", "AbuseIPDB", "threat_intel",
    {"kind": "api_key", "roles": ["api_key"], "header": "Key"},
    "https://api.abuseipdb.com/api/v2", ["api.abuseipdb.com"],
    rate_limit={"per_day": 1000},
    health={"path": "/check?ipAddress=8.8.8.8"},
    commands=[
        cmd("abuseipdb.check", "AbuseIPDB: Check IP", "GET",
            "https://api.abuseipdb.com/api/v2/check?ipAddress={{ inputs.ip | urlencode }}&maxAgeInDays={{ inputs.days | default(90) }}",
            {"ip": param("string"), "days": param("integer", maximum=365)},
            {"abuse_confidence": {"type": "integer"},
             "total_reports": {"type": "integer"},
             "country": {"type": "string"}, "isp": {"type": "string"},
             "usage_type": {"type": "string"}},
            {"abuse_confidence": "$.data.abuseConfidenceScore",
             "total_reports": "$.data.totalReports",
             "country": "$.data.countryCode", "isp": "$.data.isp",
             "usage_type": "$.data.usageType"},
            required=["ip"]),
    ],
)

otx = connector(
    "otx.v1", "AlienVault OTX", "LevelBlue", "threat_intel",
    {"kind": "api_key", "roles": ["api_key"], "header": "X-OTX-API-KEY"},
    "https://otx.alienvault.com/api/v1", ["otx.alienvault.com"],
    health={"path": "/user/me"},
    commands=[
        cmd("otx.indicator", "OTX: Indicator Detail", "GET",
            "https://otx.alienvault.com/api/v1/indicators/{{ inputs.kind | urlencode }}/{{ inputs.value | urlencode }}/general",
            {"kind": param("string", enum=["IPv4", "IPv6", "domain", "hostname",
                                          "file", "url"]),
             "value": param("string")},
            {"pulse_count": {"type": "integer"},
             "pulses": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object"}}},
            {"pulse_count": "$.pulse_info.count", "pulses": "$.pulse_info.pulses"}),
    ],
)

misp = connector(
    "misp.v2", "MISP", "MISP Project", "threat_intel",
    {"kind": "api_key", "roles": ["api_key"], "header": "Authorization"},
    "{{ integration.config.base_url }}", ["{{ integration.config.host }}"],
    health={"path": "/servers/getVersion"},
    setup=[
        field("base_url", "MISP URL", kind="url",
              placeholder="https://misp.client.example"),
    ],
    commands=[
        cmd("misp.search_attribute", "MISP: Search Attribute", "POST",
            "{{ integration.config.base_url }}/attributes/restSearch",
            {"value": param("string")},
            {"hits": {"type": "integer"},
             "attributes": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object"}}},
            {"attributes": "$.response.Attribute"},
            body={"value": "{{ inputs.value }}", "limit": 50}),

        cmd("misp.add_attribute", "MISP: Add Attribute", "POST",
            "{{ integration.config.base_url }}/attributes/add/{{ inputs.event_id | urlencode }}",
            {"event_id": param("string"), "type": param("string"),
             "value": param("string"), "comment": param("string")},
            {"id": {"type": "string"}}, {"id": "$.Attribute.id"},
            risk="medium", effect="mutating",
            required=["event_id", "type", "value"],
            body={"type": "{{ inputs.type }}", "value": "{{ inputs.value }}",
                  "comment": "{{ inputs.comment }}", "to_ids": True},
            doc="Contribute an observation back to the sharing community."),

        cmd("misp.create_event", "MISP: Create Event", "POST",
            "{{ integration.config.base_url }}/events/add",
            {"info": param("string"), "threat_level": param("integer", enum=[1,2,3,4]),
             "distribution": param("integer", enum=[0,1,2,3])},
            {"event_id": {"type": "string"}}, {"event_id": "$.Event.id"},
            risk="medium", effect="mutating", required=["info"],
            body={"info": "{{ inputs.info }}",
                  "threat_level_id": "{{ inputs.threat_level | default(2) }}",
                  "distribution": "{{ inputs.distribution | default(0) }}",
                  "analysis": 1}),
    ],
)

greynoise = connector(
    "greynoise.v3", "GreyNoise", "GreyNoise", "threat_intel",
    {"kind": "api_key", "roles": ["api_key"], "header": "key"},
    "https://api.greynoise.io", ["api.greynoise.io"],
    health={"path": "/ping"},
    commands=[
        cmd("greynoise.context", "GreyNoise: IP Context", "GET",
            "https://api.greynoise.io/v2/noise/context/{{ inputs.ip | urlencode }}",
            {"ip": param("string")},
            {"classification": {"type": "string"}, "actor": {"type": "string"},
             "seen": {"type": "boolean"}, "tags": {"type": "array"}},
            {"classification": "$.classification", "actor": "$.actor",
             "seen": "$.seen", "tags": "$.tags"},
            doc="Is this address scanning the whole internet, or only us. The "
                "single most useful false-positive reducer for perimeter alerts."),
    ],
)

urlscan = connector(
    "urlscan.v1", "urlscan.io", "urlscan.io", "threat_intel",
    {"kind": "api_key", "roles": ["api_key"], "header": "API-Key"},
    "https://urlscan.io/api/v1", ["urlscan.io"],
    health={"path": "/quotas/"},
    commands=[
        cmd("urlscan.submit", "urlscan: Submit URL", "POST",
            "https://urlscan.io/api/v1/scan/",
            {"url": param("string"),
             "visibility": param("string", enum=["public", "unlisted", "private"])},
            {"scan_id": {"type": "string"}, "result_url": {"type": "string"}},
            {"scan_id": "$.uuid", "result_url": "$.result"},
            risk="medium", effect="mutating", required=["url"],
            body={"url": "{{ inputs.url }}",
                  "visibility": "{{ inputs.visibility | default('unlisted') }}"},
            doc="Mutating because it is externally observable: submitting a URL "
                "publicly tells the attacker they are being investigated. Default "
                "visibility is unlisted for that reason."),

        cmd("urlscan.result", "urlscan: Get Result", "GET",
            "https://urlscan.io/api/v1/result/{{ inputs.scan_id | urlencode }}/",
            {"scan_id": param("string")},
            {"verdict": {"type": "object"}, "page": {"type": "object"},
             "screenshot": {"type": "string"}},
            {"verdict": "$.verdicts.overall", "page": "$.page",
             "screenshot": "$.task.screenshotURL"}),
    ],
)

shodan = connector(
    "shodan.v1", "Shodan", "Shodan", "threat_intel",
    {"kind": "api_key", "roles": ["api_key"], "query": "key"},
    "https://api.shodan.io", ["api.shodan.io"],
    health={"path": "/api-info"},
    commands=[
        cmd("shodan.host", "Shodan: Host Lookup", "GET",
            "https://api.shodan.io/shodan/host/{{ inputs.ip | urlencode }}",
            {"ip": param("string")},
            {"ports": {"type": "array"}, "org": {"type": "string"},
             "os": {"type": "string"}, "vulns": {"type": "array"}},
            {"ports": "$.ports", "org": "$.org", "os": "$.os", "vulns": "$.vulns"}),
    ],
)

return [virustotal, abuseipdb, otx, misp, greynoise, urlscan, shodan]
props.doc: Threat intelligence providers. All read-only except contributing an observation back to MISP, which is how a SOC stops only consuming intelligence.
